themes.title: Pointers and memory
mainQuestions: Look at the Node struct and pushFront. Explain how a new node becomes part of the list.
Look at the destructor. Explain what happens to each node when list goes out of scope at the end of main.
criteria: Student can describe the node structure and how the next pointer links nodes
Student knows allocated nodes must be freed and where this happens in their code

themes.title: Edge cases
mainQuestions: Look at removeFront. Explain what happens when it is called on an empty list.
criteria: Student can explain the empty-list check or admits the case is not handled

themes.title: Tracing the program
mainQuestions: Trace main from the first pushFront call. What does each print() call output?
Suppose pushFront added new nodes at the end of the list instead of the front. What would change in the output of main?
criteria: Student correctly predicts the printed order and explains why nodes appear in reverse insertion order
Student can reason about how changing the insertion point changes the list order
